wot_torque_curve.note: ALPHA full-throttle curve. node_is_measured: the node is a point EPA measured, in the sheets it built the curve from (alpha.inputs). Where it is false the node is EPA's addition, named in its generation document: model rather than data (mistake 6). measured_at_speed: the highest torque measured within 30 rpm of the node, or null where EPA measured none

closed_throttle_torque_curve.note: ALPHA closed-throttle (motoring) curve. node_is_measured as above; measured_at_speed: the lowest torque measured within 30 rpm of the node, or null where EPA measured none
